messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D cricket game, interpreting “Online all plear & office game” as online multiplayer plus offline play.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support playable cricket controls and online play.
- User requested screenshots for checks to be saved as small JPEGs; viewport at most 1280px wide; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented an arcade-style two-over cricket game with timed batting, directional aiming, optional extra runs, offline play, and PeerJS room-code multiplayer.
- Used Three.js via CDN for a stylized 3D stadium and players.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game UI, responsive styles, 3D stadium scene, batting/timing and scoring logic, offline match flow, and PeerJS host/join flow.
- Ran `node --check game.js` successfully.
- Started a local server and opened the game in Playwright; generated and inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg`.
- Fixed challenge/target label text for online mode.

### Active
- Review gameplay/browser console after the latest code edit and address any bugs.
- Verify controls and match completion, and check online flow if feasible.

### Blocked
- Browser showed a missing favicon 404 and WebGL performance warnings; no gameplay code error was identified yet.
- Online multiplayer requires external PeerJS signaling/network access and a second player.

## Next Move
1. Reload in Playwright and inspect `game.js` console errors after the latest edit.
2. Exercise batting and match completion; fix any issues found.
3. Save a fresh small JPEG screenshot and inspect only that latest image.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, match logic, controls, and online multiplayer.

## Important Context
- Local game was served at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `playwright-cli` opened the game successfully; initial console showed favicon 404 and WebGL performance warnings.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## 3D Cricket Game Complete

Built a playable arcade-style 3D cricket game called **BOUNDARY — Club Cricket**.

### Included
- 3D stadium, pitch, fielders, bowler, batter, crowd, floodlights, boundary boards, and pavilion
- Timed batting mechanic with:
  - Perfect, good, okay, poor, and missed timing
  - Directional aiming: leg side, straight, off side
  - Runs from 0–6, wickets, run-outs, boundaries
  - Optional extra-run command
- Two-over offline match mode
- Scoreboard with:
  - Runs and wickets
  - Overs and balls remaining
  - Current run rate
  - Target and opponent score
- Online multiplayer room system using PeerJS:
  - Create room
  - Share room code
  - Join a friend
  - Compare final scores
- Responsive desktop and mobile controls
- Keyboard support:
  - Arrow keys to aim
  - Space to swing
  - R to attempt an extra run
- Sound effects toggle
- Match result screen and replay flow
- Added favicon handling to remove the browser 404
- Fixed online room creation bug involving the host button

### Verification
- `node --check game.js` passes
- Tested offline match startup and batting flow
- Tested online room creation flow
- Captured and inspected the latest JPEG screenshot at:
  - `screenshots/latest.jpg`

The game is available through the existing local server at:

```text
http://localhost:3002
```
